name: First Rate Metal Fab
old_description: When you require excellent metal fabrication services, turn to First Rate Metal Fab in Manor, PA. We have a solid reputation in the industry because of our fast turnaround time and the exceptional work we deliver. If you entrust your fabrication needs to us, expect that we will provide you with products that are second to none.
about:
First Rate Metal Fab, based in Manor, Pennsylvania, was founded in 2009 as a family-owned and operated business. The company was established to address the need for outstanding metal fabrication services, combining decades of hands-on experience with modern equipment.

The shop specializes in precision sheet metal fabrication, offering design assistance, prototyping, short and long production runs, punching, bending, hardware insertion, welding, laser cutting, shearing, powder coating, assembly, and inspection. Equipment includes an Amada Vipros 345 punch press, Amada press brakes, a Bodor 3 kW fiber laser, an Amada Plusar laser, an Accu Shear, Haeger insertion presses, a Timesaver 137 surface finisher, and multiple welding systems. The facility handles materials such as stainless steel, aluminum, copper, carbon steel, and brass.

First Rate Metal Fab serves original equipment manufacturers and other businesses in the electronics, communications, and transportation industries. The company also provides local delivery throughout western and central Pennsylvania, including Erie, Greensburg, Pittsburgh, State College, and Uniontown.

The company emphasizes honesty and integrity as guiding values, quick turnaround times, proactive communication with progress updates, and a reliable, experienced team. It positions itself as a partner that treats customers like family, willing to take on prototype and short-run work while also supporting large-volume production.
